title: Levin topographic map sheet, 1973
credit: Land Information New Zealand (LINZ), via Mapspast and Wikimedia Commons.
altText: A 1973 topographic map of Levin, showing the town and two railway stations.
caption: A 1:63,360 NZMS 1 sheet for Levin, printed in 1973.
context: This is a contemporary example of New Zealand paper topographic mapping. It is not an NZLRI worksheet and does not show the inventory land units described in this chapter.
